lesson: Project "propulse" initialized. Stack: unknown
Profile V2 full vision build-out: interest tags, Where to Find Me, Contact This Station, On Air status, sidebar enhancements, and rich visitor/public profile view
When creating JSONB columns in Supabase before regenerating types, cast as 'unknown as Json' rather than 'unknown as TablesInsert<table>[column]' to avoid TS errors on missing column types
React hooks must always be called unconditionally - never place hooks after early returns. Move guard conditions after all hook calls
useMemo with an object param in the dependency array never caches because object identity changes each render - destructure to primitive values
Social links from Supabase profiles are untrusted user data - always validate URLs against safe protocols (http/https/mailto) before rendering as href
For parallel agent work, strict file ownership prevents merge conflicts - map which files each agent modifies before dispatching
ProfilePage.tsx is becoming a god file at 1174 lines - OtherProfileView should be extracted to its own file in a future refactor
Operating hours computation is duplicated 3x - should be consolidated into a shared useOperatingHours hook
Fixed S-meter dBm scale, audio/FFT stream reconnect persistence, and WFView fallback timer for IC-7300 MK2
IC-7300 MK2 (CI-V addr 0xB6) does NOT send scope/waterfall data (cmd 0x27 sub 0x00) over USB CI-V serial, even when scope is displayed on radio LCD. WFView TCP is needed for waterfall data.
React StrictMode in dev causes mount→unmount→mount cycles that close/reopen WebSocket connections. Bridge must use grace period timers to keep streams alive across brief disconnects.
When session continuations happen after context compaction, code changes from previous sessions may NOT be persisted. Always verify fixes by reading the actual file before assuming they're applied.
rawSmeterToDbm scale: CI-V raw 0-120 maps to S0-S9 (-127 to -73 dBm), raw 121-241 maps to S9+1 to S9+60 (-72 to -13 dBm). BCD codec: d1=high byte (hundreds), d2=low byte (tens+units).
Frontend stream re-subscribe must happen AFTER radio:state confirms connection, not immediately on WS connect — bridge may not have rig controller ready yet on restart.

Applied 3 fixes for SDR FlexibleSkin display issues: (1) FlexVfoDisplay.tsx: Changed root div from pointer-events-auto to pointer-events-none, added pointer-events-auto only to interactive rows (VFO/DSP badges, SlicePanelTabs) - fixes click-to-tune being blocked by VFO overlay at z-10. (2) Waterfall.tsx: Wrapped render effect body in requestAnimationFrame() with cancelAnimationFrame cleanup - fixes waterfall judder/creeping from unsynchronized vsync rendering. (3) SpectrumScope.tsx: Hoisted default empty array props (EMPTY_OVERLAYS, EMPTY_NOTCH_FILTERS, EMPTY_EQ_BANDS) to module-level constants - prevents draw-effect churn from new array refs every render. Previous session fixes still in place: removed audioFrame from SpectrumScope in FlexibleSkin (dBFS/dBm scale mismatch), gated useAudioStreamPlayer on processingChain availability (audio race condition). All changes pass npm run verify. Bridge rebuilt and restarted, connected to IC-7300 MK2 at 0xB6.

Tile engine debugging: fixed alignment rotation (Rx only, not Rx+Ry), switched from GIBS MODIS (cloudy daily photos) to ESRI World Imagery (cloud-free), fixed group transform via R3F group prop instead of useEffect
3d-tiles-renderer ECEF frame: +X=prime meridian, +Y=90E, +Z=north pole. Propulse frame: +X=prime meridian, +Y=north pole, +Z=90W. Only Rx(-PI/2) needed to align.
R3F TilesRenderer group transform must use the `group` prop (e.g. group={{scale:[...], rotation:[...]}}) not useEffect on tilesRef.current.group — R3F reconciler overwrites manual changes
NASA GIBS MODIS_Terra_CorrectedReflectance_TrueColor shows real daily satellite imagery WITH clouds — unusable for apps needing clear geography
ESRI World Imagery tiles at server.arcgisonline.com are freely accessible with CORS, no API key, cloud-free satellite composite
TilesPlugin args can be object or array — object form is cleaner and matches README examples
